review_locator: PMCID:PMC12053894, Role of Extracellular Vesicles in the Pathogenesis of Brain Metastasis
primary_title: Microenvironment-induced PTEN loss by exosomal microRNA primes brain metastasis outgrowth
decision_basis: The primary measures increased tumor-cell miR-19a and reduced PTEN mRNA after exposure to astrocyte-conditioned medium or purified astrocyte exosomes, with rescue when astrocyte exosome release is blocked.
limitations_preserved: Represent PTEN mRNA as the measured post-transcriptional target; do not add an unmeasured MIR19A transcription step or conflate mRNA with PTEN protein.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC12053894, Role of Extracellular Vesicles in the Pathogenesis of Brain Metastasis
primary_title: Microenvironment-induced PTEN loss by exosomal microRNA primes brain metastasis outgrowth
decision_basis: The primary reports reduced PTEN protein in astrocyte-exposed metastatic cells and in brain-metastatic lesions, with exosome-secretion blockade preserving PTEN and exosome add-back restoring PTEN loss.
limitations_preserved: Use PTEN protein as the measured recipient output while retaining the separate PTEN mRNA result; preserve reversible exosome-dependent loss and no receptor/TF claim.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC12053894, Role of Extracellular Vesicles in the Pathogenesis of Brain Metastasis
primary_title: Microenvironment-induced PTEN loss by exosomal microRNA primes brain metastasis outgrowth
decision_basis: The review and primary connect astrocyte-EV-induced PTEN loss to increased CCL2 secretion by metastatic tumor cells; CCL2 manipulation and PTEN rescue support the bounded relay.
limitations_preserved: This is a measured tumor-cell secretome bridge; it does not imply that CCL2 transcription or translation was separately demonstrated in the same causal experiment.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC12053894, Role of Extracellular Vesicles in the Pathogenesis of Brain Metastasis

limitations_preserved: Represent CCL2 as a secreted protein mediator and preserve the IBA1/CCR2 myeloid and brain-metastasis context; no SCI transfer.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC12053894, Role of Extracellular Vesicles in the Pathogenesis of Brain Metastasis
